papers.title: The Stability of Data Exchange in Competitive Markets
papers.authors: Yuanchen Brian Tang, Jiaxin Song, Prof. Bhaskar Ray Chaudhury, Prof. Ruta Mehta
papers.summary: When can competing firms exchange data stably? We characterize how customer rationality shapes the existence of core-stable exchanges.

papers.title: Sealed-bid Auctions on Blockchain with Timed Commitment Outsourcing
papers.authors: Jichen Li, Yuanchen Tang, Prof. Jing Chen, Prof. Xiaotie Deng
papers.summary: A practical sealed-bid auction protocol that outsources timed-commitment puzzles and incentivizes truthful reporting by bidders and solvers.

research.title: Competitive Data Market
research.advisors: Prof. Bhaskar Ray Chaudhury and Prof. Ruta Mehta
research.summary: I study the stability of data exchange among competing firms and how customer behavior affects incentives to cooperate.
research.results: A core-stable exchange always exists in fully rational markets for any monotone continuous prediction and utility functions, when customers choose the top-performing firm. With partially rational customers and logit-style demand, core-stable exchanges may fail to exist.

research.title: Large Aggregative Markov Games
research.summary: I work on provably efficient multi-agent planning in large general-sum Markov games, motivated by congestion control and public goods provision.
research.results: We developed provably efficient algorithms for a class of Nash-computable games in which unilateral deviations have bounded influence on rewards and dynamics.

research.title: Sealed-bid Auctions on Blockchain
research.methods: Auction theory · Mechanism design · Cryptography · Incentive analysis
research.summary: I studied how to make blockchain auctions practical by outsourcing the cost of solving timed-commitment puzzles.
research.results: We introduced a puzzle-outsourcing market, designed a practical protocol that incentivizes truthful reporting of bidders' and solvers' private values, and derived an optimal pricing strategy for auctioneers.

education.degree: B.S. in Computer Science · Turing Class
